description: Questions over the demo corpus (demo-docs/manifest.json). 'expected' is the file that answers the question and 'section' a substring of the chunk heading (or 'page N' for PDFs). Unanswerable questions have expected = null: no document answers them, so the right result is 'not found'. Written before any results were seen; don't add questions to make a feature look good (add a new slice instead).
